journey.name: Configure stick touch behavior
journey.description: Start on Controller with Bluetooth stopped. This changes local settings and finishes at stick defaults and 8 ms. Use a dedicated test profile/device if existing preferences must be retained.

actions.action: Tap Quick actions.
Scroll the drawer until Stick defaults is visible.
Tap Stick defaults.
Verify that Recenter sticks on touch is on and EXTRA ACTIVATION REACH shows 24 dp.
Tap the Recenter sticks on touch switch.
Verify that the switch is off and the extra activation reach slider is disabled.
Tap the Recenter sticks on touch switch.
Move the EXTRA ACTIVATION REACH slider to its maximum.
Verify that EXTRA ACTIVATION REACH shows 48 dp.
Tap Stick defaults.
Verify that Recenter sticks on touch is on and EXTRA ACTIVATION REACH shows 24 dp.
Scroll the drawer to the scheduling interval choices.
Tap 16 ms.
Press Android Back.
Tap Diagnostics.
Verify that Local sender measurements describes a 16 ms analog scheduling interval.
Tap Back to controller.
Tap Quick actions.
Scroll the drawer to the scheduling interval choices.
Tap 8 ms.
Press Android Back.
